in_marathi.name: Snehalata
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Heart bound, attached to love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Snehalata हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from Sanskrit, Sneha (heart) and Lata (bound). Snehalata means one who is heart bound, attached to love. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of a goddess who embodies love and compassion. She is believed to nurture and protect the emotional bonds between loved ones.
